blocks.en: Market is the most popular system through which players can buy and sell items in New Eden. The other common systems are contracts and direct trades.
blocks.zh: 市场是新伊甸中玩家买卖物品最常用的途径。其他常见方式还有合同和直接交易。

blocks.en: The market is essentially an automated list of item exchange contracts: buy orders and sell orders. Since orders can be partially filled and searched easily, it tends to be a lot more convenient than trading through contracts, although the basic principle is the same. Another advantage of the market is that it's easy to see the price and quantity that items are actually selling for, using the market details tab.
blocks.zh: 市场本质上是一份自动化的物品交易合约清单：买单和卖单。由于订单可以部分成交、搜索也很方便，它通常比通过合同交易方便得多，尽管基本原理是一样的。市场的另一个优点是，通过市场详情页可以很容易看到物品实际成交的价格和数量。

blocks.en: Each region has its own regional market. Each station and Upwell structure with market service module has access to the market.
blocks.zh: 每个星域都有自己的区域市场。每个空间站，以及装有市场服务模块的昇威建筑，都可以访问市场。

blocks.en: Advantages of market trading
blocks.zh: 市场交易的优点

en: Easy to get started: You can start trading right away on a character with no skills, and the amount of skill training needed compared to other professions is fairly low. The only skill you really need to start with is Trade, without which you'll probably feel a little limited in the number of orders you can have open.

Easy to do during war: With a small investment in skills (Marketing, Procurement and Daytrading to level 2) you can easily station trade in one system while docked up in another, or use an alt to trade in other ways.

Time-flexible: A lot of trading happens while docked up, and it's easy to go AFK with no real danger most of the time. While this isn't true during hauling, good hauls tend to be fairly short and you can always dock up halfway through.
Scalable: With more money you can invest in more items making you more money.
zh: 上手容易：没有任何技能的角色也能立刻开始交易，而且与其他职业相比需要训练的技能相当少。起步时真正需要的只有贸易学，没有它你可能会觉得能同时挂的订单数量有点受限。
战争期间也方便进行：只需在技能上稍作投入（市场学、供给学和投机技巧练到 2 级），就可以停靠在一个星系里，轻松地在另一个星系做站内交易，或者用小号以其他方式交易。
时间灵活：很多交易都是停靠在站里完成的，大多数时候挂机离开也没有什么实际危险。运货时虽然不是这样，但好的运输路线通常都比较短，而且你随时可以中途停靠。
可扩展：钱越多，能投资的物品就越多，赚的钱也就越多。

blocks.en: Skills
blocks.zh: 技能

blocks.en: Trade skills can be divided into three groups:
blocks.zh: 贸易技能可以分为三类：

en: Skills that increase maximum number of active orders orders: Trade, Retail, Wholesale, Tycoon.
Skills that allow you to buy and sell things remotely: Marketing, Procurement, Daytrading, Visibility.
Skills that reduce trading overhead: Accounting, Broker Relations, Advanced Broker Relations.
zh: 增加最大活跃订单数的技能：贸易学、零售技巧、批发技巧、商业巨头。
允许远程买卖物品的技能：市场学、供给学、投机技巧、市场观测学。
降低交易成本的技能：会计学、经纪人关系学、高级经纪人关系学。

blocks.en: Skills that increase the number of market slots: With no trade skills a character can set up 5 simultaneous orders.
blocks.zh: 增加市场订单栏位的技能：没有任何贸易技能时，一个角色最多可以同时挂 5 个订单。

en: Trade (1x, 30k ISK) – grants 4 additional orders per level.
Retail (2x, 125k ISK) – grants 8 additional orders per level.
Wholesale (4x, 35M ISK) – grants 16 additional orders per level.
Tycoon (6x, 125M ISK) – grants 32 additional orders per level.
zh: 贸易学（1x，30k ISK）– 每级增加 4 个订单。
零售技巧（2x，125k ISK）– 每级增加 8 个订单。
批发技巧（4x，35M ISK）– 每级增加 16 个订单。
商业巨头（6x，125M ISK）– 每级增加 32 个订单。

blocks.en: With all these skills trained to level 5 a character can manage up to 305 orders.
blocks.zh: 这些技能全部练到 5 级后，一个角色最多可以管理 305 个订单。

blocks.en: Skills that allow buying and selling remotely:
blocks.zh: 允许远程买卖的技能：

en: Marketing (3x, 3.5M ISK) – allows to setup sell orders remotely.

Procurement (3x, 1.5M ISK) – allows to setup buy orders remotely. The range of these buy orders are controlled by the Visibility skill. E.g. with level 5 Procurement skill orders can be set up anywhere in the region, but with level 0 of Visibility they will be limited to the station where they are set.
Daytrading (1x, 15M ISK) – allows to manage orders remotely.

Visibility (3x, 7.5M ISK) - increases maximum range of remote buy orders, so sellers can fill such orders from any station with this range of the remote buy order. Every buy order can have own effective range limited to this skill.
level 0: limited to current station
level 1: anywhere within current solar system
level 2: 5 jumps
level 3: 10 jumps
level 4: 20 jumps
level 5: entire region
zh: 市场学（3x，3.5M ISK）– 允许远程挂卖单。
供给学（3x，1.5M ISK）– 允许远程挂买单。这些买单的范围由市场观测学技能决定。例如，供给学 5 级时可以在星域内任何地方挂单，但如果市场观测学为 0 级，买单范围只限于挂单所在的空间站。
投机技巧（1x，15M ISK）– 允许远程管理订单。
市场观测学（3x，7.5M ISK）- 增加远程买单的最大范围，卖家可以在远程买单范围内的任何空间站完成这类订单。每个买单都可以设置自己的有效范围，上限由该技能决定。
0 级：仅限当前空间站
1 级：当前星系内任何地方
2 级：5 跳
5 级：整个星域

blocks.en: The info for these skills can be misleading. Sadly, these skills do not magically move goods around. For example, Procurement will not allow you to buy goods in a distant system and have them appear in your current station's hangar. What these skills do is allow you to buy and sell goods that are not in your current station/system. If you are a station trader, for example, you hang out somewhere else from your goods; this increases safety, because trade hubs tend to attract PvP action. Similarly, you can deliver your salvage to a trade hub then go back to missioning where the missions are, while still managing the sale of your salvage.
blocks.zh: 这些技能的说明可能会让人误解。遗憾的是，这些技能并不能神奇地把货物搬来搬去。例如，供给学并不能让你在遥远的星系买下货物，然后让货物出现在你当前空间站的机库里。这些技能的作用是让你能够买卖不在当前空间站/星系里的货物。比如你是站内交易者，你可以待在离货物较远的地方；这样更安全，因为交易中心往往会吸引 PvP 活动。同样，你可以把打捞品送到交易中心，然后回到任务所在的地方继续刷任务，同时仍然可以管理打捞品的销售。

blocks.en: Skills that reduce overhead:
blocks.zh: 降低交易成本的技能：

en: Accounting (3x, 5M ISK) - reduces the sales tax by 11% per level from 8% to 3.6% at level 5.

Broker Relations (2x, 125k ISK) – reduces the broker fee by 0.3 percentage points per level (10% reduction per level ignoring the standings). At level 5 this brings you from 3% to 1.5%. Also reduces the relist fee. This fee is also affected by standings between the trader and the corporation and faction that own the station. Has no effect when trading in player owned structures.
Advanced Broker Relations (3x, 20M ISK) - reduces the relist fee paid when updating order price by 5 percentage points per level (10% reduction per level).
zh: 会计学（3x，5M ISK）- 每级降低 11% 的交易税，5 级时从 8% 降到 3.6%。
经纪人关系学（2x，125k ISK）– 每级降低中介费 0.3 个百分点（不考虑声望时每级降低 10%）。5 级时可以从 3% 降到 1.5%。同时也会降低改单费。该费用还受交易者与空间站所属军团和势力之间声望的影响。在玩家建筑中交易时无效。
高级经纪人关系学（3x，20M ISK）- 每级将修改订单价格时支付的改单费降低 5 个百分点（每级降低 10%）。

blocks.en: Taxes
blocks.zh: 税费

blocks.en: Any time the market is used there are taxes that need to be paid. There are three different taxes: sales tax, broker's fee and relist fee.
blocks.zh: 每次使用市场都需要缴纳税费。税费共有三种：交易税、中介费和改单费。

blocks.en: A station trader with zero standings will pay between 5.1% (at max skills) and 11% of the order price as fees/taxes. This is important to take into account when calculating your profit, but of course the standings can change that further. With max skills and max standings a station trader will pay 4.6% of the order price as fees/taxes.
blocks.zh: 一个零声望的站内交易者需要支付订单价格的 5.1%（技能满级）到 11% 作为税费。计算利润时必须把这一点考虑进去，当然声望还能进一步改变这个数字。技能和声望都满的情况下，站内交易者需要支付订单价格的 4.6% 作为税费。

blocks.en: Sales tax
blocks.zh: 交易税

blocks.en: When an item is sold on the market the seller will also pay sales tax. The base sales tax is 7.5% and is reduced by 11% per level in Accounting (3.37% at max skills). The sales tax shows up in the wallet as transaction tax.
blocks.zh: 物品在市场上卖出时，卖家还需要支付交易税。基础交易税为 7.5%，会计学每级降低 11%（技能满级时为 3.37%）。交易税在钱包里显示为交易税（transaction tax）。

blocks.en: Sales tax%=7.5%*(1−(11%×Accounting level))
Sales tax is always paid to NPC corporation Secure Commerce Commission (SCC).
blocks.zh: 交易税总是支付给 NPC 军团商业安全委员会（SCC）。

blocks.en: Broker's fee
blocks.zh: 中介费

blocks.en: Broker's fee is paid every time a sell or buy order with duration other than "immediate" is created. The broker's fee is a percentage value of the total value of the created market order. The broker's fee is paid immediately when the order is created. If the order is taken down or expires the fee is not paid back. The minimum broker's fee is 100 ISK.
blocks.zh: 每次创建期限不是“立即”的卖单或买单时，都需要支付中介费。中介费按所创建市场订单总价值的百分比计算，在创建订单时立即支付。如果订单被撤下或过期，中介费不会退还。中介费最低为 100 ISK。

blocks.en: In NPC stations the base broker's fee is 3%. The broker fee can be reduced with the Broker Relations skill and NPC standings.
blocks.zh: 在 NPC 空间站中，基础中介费为 3%。中介费可以通过经纪人关系学技能和 NPC 声望降低。

blocks.en: Corporation standings contribute 2/3 of that of faction standings. Note that the unmodified standing is used for the calculation so skills that increase standings have no effect on broker's fees.
blocks.zh: 军团声望的作用是势力声望的 2/3。注意，计算时使用的是未修正的声望，所以提高声望的技能对中介费没有影响。

blocks.en: The equation for the NPC broker's fee percentage is
blocks.zh: NPC 中介费百分比的公式为

blocks.en: Broker's fee%=3%−0.3%×Broker Relations level−0.03%×faction standing−0.02%×corporation standing
blocks.zh: 中介费%=3%−0.3%×经纪人关系学等级−0.03%×势力声望−0.02%×军团声望

blocks.en: With no skills or standing the broker's fee is 3%. With broker relations V, the broker's fee is reduced to 1.5%. With 10 faction and corp (i.e. perfect) standing the fee is further reduced to 1%.
blocks.zh: 没有技能和声望时，中介费为 3%。经纪人关系学 5 级时，中介费降到 1.5%。势力和军团声望都为 10（即满声望）时，费用进一步降到 1%。

blocks.en: In player owned Upwell structure markets the broker's fee is a fixed SCC surcharge of 0.5% plus a percentage set by the structure owner and is not affected by any skills. The owner may set different fees for different standing levels. The minimum owner fee is 0% . The minimum broker fee is 100 ISK.
blocks.zh: 在玩家拥有的昇威建筑市场中，中介费由固定的 0.5% SCC 附加费加上建筑所有者设定的百分比组成，不受任何技能影响。所有者可以为不同声望等级设置不同的费率。所有者费率最低为 0%。中介费最低为 100 ISK。

blocks.en: Broker's fee%=0.5%+Owner%
blocks.zh: 中介费%=0.5%+所有者费率%

blocks.en: Leading to a broker's fee of:
blocks.zh: 由此得出中介费：

blocks.en: Broker's fee=Market order value×Broker's fee%
blocks.zh: 中介费=市场订单价值×中介费%

blocks.en: Relist fee
blocks.zh: 改单费

blocks.en: When an order is modified you will need to again pay a broker's fee. This broker's fee is reduced by a relist discount with a base reduction of 50%. The relist discount can be increased by the Advanced Broker Relations skill.
blocks.zh: 修改订单时需要再次支付中介费。这笔中介费会享受改单折扣，基础折扣为 50%。改单折扣可以通过高级经纪人关系学技能提高。

blocks.en: The relist fee is calculated as
blocks.zh: 改单费的计算公式为

blocks.en: Relist fee=(100%−(50%+6%×Advanced Broker Relations level))×Broker's fee%×New order value+Broker's fee%×max⁡(New order value−Old order value,0)
blocks.zh: 改单费=(100%−(50%+6%×高级经纪人关系学等级))×中介费%×新订单价值+中介费%×max⁡(新订单价值−旧订单价值,0)

blocks.en: where Broker's fee % is same as when setting up the market order described in the above section. The minimum relist fee is 100 ISK.
blocks.zh: 其中中介费 % 与上一节所述挂市场订单时相同。改单费最低为 100 ISK。

blocks.zh: 有些情况下，修改旧订单的花费可能比撤下旧订单再挂新单还要高。

blocks.en: Broker fee:
blocks.zh: 中介费：

blocks.en: You will need to pay 140k ISK relist fee. If you just create a new order you need to pay 100k ISK broker's fee.
blocks.zh: 你需要支付 140k ISK 的改单费。而如果直接新挂一个订单，只需支付 100k ISK 的中介费。

blocks.en: Trading using the Market
blocks.zh: 使用市场进行交易

blocks.en: The main method of trading is doing what other players can't be bothered to do: either they're too lazy or the opportunity cost is too big. Most market activity occurs in and around trade hubs.
blocks.zh: 交易的主要方法，就是去做其他玩家懒得做的事：要么是他们太懒，要么是机会成本太高。大部分市场活动都发生在交易中心及其周边。

blocks.en: Station Trading
blocks.zh: 站内交易

blocks.en: Station trading is trading in its most basic form. You buy low and sell high.
blocks.zh: 站内交易是最基本的交易形式：低买高卖。

blocks.en: Basically, you want to find items with a reasonable volume traded and a significant difference in buy and sell order prices within the same station. A large source of these types of items comes from NPC loot: players run missions, collect loot and just want to sell it for a quick buck, since they don't have the time or the Trade skills to set up sell orders for everything. On the other hand, players searching for one will pay quite a bit more since they can't get it anywhere else.
blocks.zh: 简单来说，你要找的是在同一个空间站里成交量还算可观、买单和卖单价格差距明显的物品。这类物品很大一部分来自 NPC 掉落物：玩家刷任务、收集战利品，只想尽快换点钱，因为他们没时间、也没有贸易技能去给每样东西挂卖单。另一方面，想要某件物品的玩家会愿意多付不少钱，因为他们在别处买不到。

blocks.en: The simple rule of thumb is buy low and sell high. For station trading to be performed effectively, ensure that your sell order's gross profit minus your buy order's cost minus taxation still leaves a profit! Setting up buy and sell orders on multiple items minimizes risk of a market price crash on any one particular item. If you can make 20,000 ISK on an item and manage to trade 100 of these per day this will give you 2,000,000 ISK. Do this with 50 different products and this equates to 100,000,000 ISK per day!
blocks.zh: 简单的经验法则就是低买高卖。要想有效地做站内交易，一定要确保卖单的毛收入减去买单成本再减去税费后仍有利润！同时在多种物品上挂买单和卖单，可以降低某一种物品市场价格崩盘的风险。如果一件物品能赚 20,000 ISK，每天能交易 100 件，就能赚 2,000,000 ISK。在 50 种不同商品上这样做，每天就是 100,000,000 ISK！

blocks.en: Start small, reinvest, and you will soon see your total ISK grow very quickly. When you start working with billions of ISK you can trade higher priced items, which, in turn, can increase your margins and also price out some of the competition!
blocks.zh: 从小做起，不断再投资，你很快就会看到总资产迅速增长。当你开始用数十亿 ISK 做交易时，就可以交易更高价的物品，这反过来又能提高利润率，还能把一部分竞争对手挤出局！

blocks.en: Station trading is all about volume. Your margins are often thin, and you'll need to save money everywhere you can. That means training Broker Relations and Accounting to 5.
blocks.zh: 站内交易靠的是走量。利润率往往很薄，你需要在每个能省钱的地方省钱。这意味着要把经纪人关系学和会计学练到 5 级。

blocks.en: Early in your trading career, these fractional percentages have a minimal impact i.e. if trained to level 5, you need to trade 667 million ISK of goods to earn back the 5 million ISK you spent on the Accounting skillbook. As you build your trading volume, however, these reductions are quite meaningful. Without getting into the math, training Broker Relations and Accounting to 5 will increase your profits by 11% (assuming you do not need to modify your offer).
blocks.zh: 在交易生涯初期，这些零点几个百分点的影响很小。例如练到 5 级后，你需要交易价值 6.67 亿 ISK 的货物，才能赚回购买会计学技能书花掉的 500 万 ISK。但随着交易量增大，这些减免就非常可观了。不算细账的话，把经纪人关系学和会计学练到 5 级可以让你的利润增加 11%（假设你不需要改单）。

blocks.en: Cross region trading
blocks.zh: 跨星域交易

blocks.en: Sometimes items have different values in different areas of space. You can buy low in one place and sell high in another place.
blocks.zh: 有时同一件物品在不同区域的价值不同。你可以在一个地方低价买入，再到另一个地方高价卖出。

blocks.en: Basically, you buy some goods at one station, load them up into your hauling ship, carry them off to another station and sell them for profit. This works because most players don't have the ships or the time to move everything themselves. Finding good trade routes is hard (and changes on a daily basis), so most players use an external tool such as EVE Trade. However, there are usually certain routes that are profitable in general, such as hauling stuff from mission hubs, where mission runners dump their loots, to trading hubs where there is less supply.
blocks.zh: 简单来说，就是在一个空间站买入货物，装进运输舰，运到另一个空间站卖掉赚取利润。之所以能赚钱，是因为大多数玩家没有合适的船，也没有时间自己去搬运所有东西。找到好的贸易路线很难（而且每天都在变化），所以大多数玩家会使用 EVE Trade 之类的外部工具。不过通常也有一些总体上能赚钱的路线，比如把任务玩家倾销战利品的任务中心的货物，运到供应较少的交易中心。

blocks.en: See Hauling for more details on moving items from one place to another.
blocks.zh: 关于把物品从一个地方运到另一个地方的更多细节，请参见运输。

blocks.zh: 指南：

en: Creating an Alt Hauler

zh: 创建运输小号

blocks.en: Speculation
blocks.zh: 投机

blocks.en: Speculation is the act of buying goods in the hope that their price will rise in the future. For example, PLEX prices can rise significantly during the summer holidays, so buying them earlier in the year and selling them during the summer can create a large profit. Speculation can also occur on patch changes or market stampedes.
blocks.zh: 投机是指买入货物、期待其价格在未来上涨的行为。例如，伊甸币（PLEX）的价格在暑假期间可能大幅上涨，所以在年初买入、暑期卖出可以获得丰厚的利润。版本更新或市场恐慌性抢购时也会出现投机机会。

blocks.en: Speculative market trading requires you to have good understanding on the wider EVE economy. Where do items come from, where do items go to, how does update on X affect item Y? Owning a crystal ball also helps.
blocks.zh: 投机交易需要你对 EVE 整体经济有很好的理解。物品从哪里来，流向哪里，X 的更新会如何影响物品 Y？如果有颗水晶球就更好了。

blocks.en: Tips and Tricks
blocks.zh: 技巧与窍门

blocks.en: As with other aspects of EVE, the first rule of trading is to never invest what you can't afford to lose.
blocks.zh: 和 EVE 的其他方面一样，交易的第一条规则是：永远不要投入你输不起的钱。

blocks.en: Finding items that are good to trade
blocks.zh: 寻找适合交易的物品

blocks.en: There is an incredibly simple 3-step plan for finding good trading items:
blocks.zh: 寻找好的交易物品有一个极其简单的三步法：

en: Click on a market category, and start looking at the orders and market details for each item.
Switch to another category, and keep looking at each item.
Look at items some more.
zh: 点开一个市场分类，开始查看每件物品的订单和市场详情。
切换到另一个分类，继续查看每件物品。
再多看看物品。

blocks.en: With that said, it's important to know what you're looking for, and hopefully the burger method and the tips on this page should be enough. Generally, for station trading, you want to find items that:
blocks.zh: 话虽如此，重要的是知道自己在找什么，希望汉堡法和本页的技巧能够帮到你。一般来说，做站内交易时，你要找的物品应该：

en: have a high and fairly constant demand. You can check item demand by looking at the volume sold chart in the market details. While some items might have huge margins, if the volume sold is small or infrequent then there is much more risk associated with that item.

actually sell for the buy and sell orders listed. You can check this by looking at the market details and seeing whether the range of prices includes the current best buy and sell orders. The median price should be somewhere between the two.
zh: 需求量高且相当稳定。你可以通过市场详情中的成交量图表查看物品需求。有些物品利润率可能很高，但如果成交量小或者成交不频繁，这件物品的风险就要大得多。
确实能以挂出的买单和卖单价格成交。你可以查看市场详情，看看成交价格区间是否包含当前最高买单价和最低卖单价。中位价应该介于两者之间。

blocks.en: Good items to trade are (depending on region and current market) meta-4 items (e.g. Arbalest launchers): they can't be produced and some of them have better or the same attributes as their T2 counterparts.
blocks.zh: 适合交易的物品（取决于星域和当前市场）有 meta-4 物品（例如劲弩系列发射器）：它们无法制造，其中一些的属性甚至与对应的 T2 版本相同或更好。

blocks.en: Remember to diversify between different items so that if your market breaks down you don't lose all your money.
blocks.zh: 记得分散投资不同的物品，这样即使某个市场崩了，你也不会血本无归。

blocks.en: Trend lines
blocks.zh: 趋势线

blocks.en: Trend lines are used in the real world to help self brokers and stock brokers find out future events in the stock market, or more commonly known as a technical analysis. To use a trend line all you need to do is find a way to draw a line from peak to peak and trough to trough in the line graph on price history on an item. You will want to draw a line that hits at least 2 to 3 peaks and another that hits 2 to 3 troughs. This will tell you that the price should fall between the 2 lines and if the prices hits one of the lines or go a little past it then its time to buy or sell the item in EVE. The trick to this in both EVE and the real world is to do this and know what you're doing as fast and right as possible.
blocks.zh: 在现实世界中，趋势线被个人投资者和股票经纪人用来预测股市的未来走势，也就是通常所说的技术分析。使用趋势线时，你只需在物品价格历史的折线图上，把峰与峰、谷与谷连成线。你要画一条至少经过 2 到 3 个峰的线，再画一条经过 2 到 3 个谷的线。这表示价格应该会落在这两条线之间，如果价格碰到其中一条线或稍微越过它，就是在 EVE 里买入或卖出该物品的时机。无论在 EVE 还是现实世界，诀窍都在于尽可能又快又准地做到这一点，并且清楚自己在做什么。

blocks.en: You should be able to look at a graph in 5 minutes and say if it's a good buy or sell for you if you're buying and selling short term. The only trick to using something is it must be straight. If worst comes to worst you can press print screen, paste the image into paint and make the trend line there but if you do this you will lose some valuable time.
blocks.zh: 如果你做的是短线买卖，应该能在 5 分钟内看完一张图表，判断它对你来说是该买还是该卖。使用趋势线的唯一诀窍是线必须是直的。实在不行，你可以按截屏键，把图片粘贴到画图软件里画趋势线，但这样会浪费一些宝贵的时间。

blocks.en: Because there is so much information already out there here is a link that gets in detail on what you should do to make and read a trend line.
blocks.zh: 由于网上已经有大量相关资料，这里有一个链接，详细介绍了如何绘制和解读趋势线。

blocks.en: Lastly here is another video that shows you how the trend line works on line graphs.
blocks.zh: 最后，这里还有一个视频，演示趋势线在折线图上的用法。
